The National Society of Black Engineers chapter at Texas State University in San Marcos. Open to every student in engineering, computer science, and technology.

Become a member See upcoming events

Who we are

Our mission is to increase the number of culturally responsible Black engineers who excel academically, succeed professionally, and positively impact the community.

Academic excellence

Study halls, tutoring, and test prep so members stay on track in their toughest courses.

Professional development

Resume reviews, mock interviews, company info sessions, and trips to NSBE regional and national conferences.

Community impact

Service projects around San Marcos and STEM outreach that introduces K–12 students to engineering.

Get involved

Every member can join a committee. It's the fastest way to build leadership experience and meet people outside your classes.

Membership

Recruits new members, tracks points, and keeps everyone connected through the semester.

Programs

Plans general body meetings, socials, and chapter events from start to finish.

Academic Excellence

Runs study sessions, tutoring, and recognizes members who hit their GPA goals.

Community Service

Organizes volunteer projects with local schools and organizations.

Pre-College Initiative

Brings engineering to middle and high school students through workshops and mentoring.

Professional Development

Connects members with employers, internships, and career prep workshops.

Join our chapter

Membership is open to all Texas State students. Here's how to get started.

  1. Come to a meeting

    Stop by any general body meeting to meet the board and current members.

  2. Register with national NSBE

    Create your national membership at mynsbe.nsbe.org and select Texas State as your chapter.

  3. Fill out the membership form

    Complete the chapter form and pay your dues in one place. Open the membership form.

  4. Join our GroupMe

    Get meeting reminders and event updates. Join the GroupMe.
